text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: RMS represents the DC-equivalent heating value of a waveform

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: For a pure sinusoid with no DC offset, the signed average over a full period is zero while RMS is positive. The average of the rectified waveform is a
different quantity. In a 10 Ω resistor the displayed sine dissipates 5 W on average.
